# Local UI dependencies

- Bootstrap 5.3.3 CSS/bundle: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/ (MIT, LICENSE included).
- Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3 CSS/WOFF/WOFF2: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/ (MIT, LICENSE included).
- Noto Sans Regular/Bold in ../fonts: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/tree/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSans (SIL Open Font License, OFL.txt included; used for Vietnamese PDF embedding).

Existing pinned UI versions were retained and downloaded into the repository for demo reliability. No external font/CDN request is required to render the app. Gemini still requires Internet. Dependencies are not an assertion of a security audit; update deliberately with regression testing.
